title: Winged Fallen Angel
description: A blue-skinned man with large, ornate blue and gold wings stands on broken stone steps in a ruined classical landscape. He wears a tattered beige trench coat over a patterned suit, with blue liquid dripping from his wings, body, and the surrounding crumbling columns.
prompt: A surreal painting of a blue-skinned man with large ornate blue and gold wings standing on broken marble steps in a ruined classical landscape. He wears a tattered beige trench coat and patterned suit, blue liquid dripping from his wings and body onto the cracked stone. Golden halo above his head, dramatic blue and gold paint drips and splatters throughout the scene, melancholic atmosphere.
